paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh na it un adan thusehte, adante, avaihawmte leh athupiakte na zui gige ding uh ahi.
heading: Pathian Thupina
english: Therefore you shall love Yahweh your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

paite: Tu in thei un, TOUPA na Pathian sawina, athupidan, aban hatdan, aban zakdan,
english: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,

paite: achiamtehnate, athilhih, Aigupta gamsung a Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh tung leh agamsung pumpi a ahihte;
english: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

paite: Aigupta sepaihte leh asakol leh akangtalai tung a athilhihte; nou ahon delhzui ua, Tuipi San a atumsakdan, tutan a TOUPA'N ahihmanthatdante;
english: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;

paite: hiai mun na tun masiah ua gamdai a na tung ua athilhihtheihdante;
english: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

paite: Reuben tapa Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram tung a ahihdan; lei in akam akat a, Israel mite tengteng lak a amaute leh a-inkuanpihte uh leh apuaninte uh leh aganhon tengteng uh avalh vekdante thei lou na suante uh kiang a thu gen ka hi kei hi.
english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

paite: Na mit ngei ua TOUPA'N thil thupitak, ahih tengteng mute kiang a thugen ka hi zaw hi.
english: but your eyes have seen all of Yahweh’s great work which he did.

paite: Huaiziak in na hong hat ua, luah dia na va zot gam uh na luahtheihna ding un, tuni a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng na zuih ding uh ahi.
heading: Gam Chiam Vualzawlnate
english: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

paite: Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, na pi-le-pute leh asuante kiang a piak dia TOUPA'N akichiamna gam a na ten sawttheihna ding un.
english: and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: Huai na va luah ding uh gam, na hong pawtna uh Aigupta gam, anteh-louhing huan a haichi na tuh ua, na khe ua tui na buah uh bang uh ahi kei hi.
english: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

paite: Na va luah ding uh gam zaw, mualte leh phaizangte leh van vuahtui mu gam ahi zaw hi.
english: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh zonkhiak gam ahi a; TOUPA na Pathian uh mit kum thak a pan kum tawp pha atuk gigena gam ahi.
english: a land which Yahweh your God cares for. Yahweh your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua a-nna sem dia tu a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng phatuamngaitak a na zuih uleh,
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

paite: na gam vuahtui uh ahun geihgeih in, vuahtui ke masa leh vuahtui ke nanung ka hon pe dia, huchi in na buh uh, na uain uh, na thau uh na seklut thei ding uhi.
english: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

paite: Na gante uh a ding in leng na loute uah loupa ka hon sawl dia, nou leng na ne ding ua, na tai ding uhi.
english: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

paite: Pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw na lungtang uh khem in a-om dia, na pial ding ua, pathian dangte nna sem in, na be kha ding uh.
english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

paite: Na huchih uleh TOUPA na tung uah athangpai dia, van akhak dia, vuah azu kei dia, lei in agah apiangsak kei ding. Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon piak, gam hoih a pan na mangthang pah ding uhi.
english: and Yahweh’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which Yahweh gives you.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai ka thute na lungtang uleh na lungsim uah khum unla, chiamtehna ding in na ban uah na vial ding ua, na mit kikal uah talgakna ding in leng a-om ding ahi.
english: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

paite: Huaite na tate uh na sinsak ding ua, na inn ua na tut lai un, lampi a na pai lai un, na lup lai un, na thoh chiang un na gen ding uhi.
english: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

paite: Na inn kongkhak biangte uah, na kongkhakte uah na gelh ding uh ahi.
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

paite: Huchi in na pi-le-pute uh piak dia akichiamna gam ah na damsung nite uh leh na tate uh damsung nite leitung a vante nite bang in asausak ding hi.
english: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh alampi tengteng zui ding leh amah len tinten ding a phatuamngaitak a hiai thupiak nou ka hon piak tengteng na zuih peuhmah uleh;
english: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—

paite: TOUPA'N hiai nam tengteng ahon delhkhiaksak dia, nou sang a thupizaw leh thilhihtheizaw namte gam na luah ding uhi.
english: then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

paite: Na khepek ua na sikna peuh uh nou a ahi dia, gamdai a pan leh Lebanon tang a pan lui, Euphrates Luipi a pan tumlam tuipi pha in na gam uh ahi ding hi.
english: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

paite: Kuamah in hon pha kei dia; TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua agensa bang in na va sik ding uh gam tengteng ah noute kihtakna leh lauhna a-omsak ding.
english: No man will be able to stand before you. Yahweh your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.

paite: Ngai un, tuni in na ma uah vualzawlna leh hamsia ka koih hi:
english: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte, tua ka hon piakte na zuih uleh, vualzawlna ahi ding hi.
english: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, which I command you today;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zuih kei uleh, na theih ngei louh uh pathian dangte be ding a tua ka hon thupiakte na pialsan uleh bel, hamsiat na hi ding uh.
english: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, na va luah ding uh gam a TOUPA na Pathian un hon pilut chiang in, Gerizim tang ah vualzawlna, Ebal tang ah hamsiatna na koih ding uhi.
english: It shall happen, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

paite: Nitumna khen, Arabah a om, Kanaante gam, Gilgal zawn Moreh tosaw sik, Jordan gal ate ahi kei uh maw?
english: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam va luah ding in Jordan na kan ding ua, na luah ding ua, huai ah na teng ding uhi.
english: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

paite: Tua na ma ua ka koih, dan leh vaihawm tengteng zui ding in na pilvang ding uh ahi.
english: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.
